svg.title: Eldrow
svg.desc: The Eldrow wordmark beneath one guess's real feedback partition. TRAIN splits the 2,315 bundled Wordle answers into 137 feedback groups, drawn as branches to bars ranked by size: 264 answers share the all-gray pattern, and 32 patterns leave a single answer. The cycle selects the 24-answer group where T, R and A are present but misplaced. A common follow-up guess, WATER, splits those 24 answers into 14 groups of 4, 4, 2, 2, 2, 2 and 8 singles, one of them WATER itself. WATER illustrates a split; it is not the solver's choice. The branch then folds back to rest.
